about: The mask bench's contenders (MSK-38): named ways of making Subject, Sky and Background masks. `runner`: redlamp (`redlamp mask --batch`, with `env`), python (a model in research/prototypes/masking/bench/candidates.py, its region given Redlamp's edges when `edges` is redlamp), or lightroom (decoded from Lightroom desktop's exports, never run). `licence`: cleared (ships today), evaluation (would need a decision row to ship), commercial (would need a paid licence), cloud (through the photographer's key, DEC-39), reference (never shipped or committed).

contenders.label: Redlamp
contenders.notes: Today's Redlamp, with the optional models this Mac has downloaded (Segment Anything 2.1 tiny and Depth Anything 3 for Sky, ViTMatte's strands for Subject and Background).

contenders.label: Redlamp without downloads
contenders.notes: What a Mac without the optional models makes: Sky from the classical estimate, Subject and Background without ViTMatte's strands.

contenders.label: Redlamp on a lifted analysis render
contenders.notes: Today's Redlamp with its masks found on an analysis render whose shadows are lifted and highlights recovered (Shadows +60, Highlights −60), instead of the default develop (MSK-39).

contenders.label: Redlamp, Subject from Vision's salient instances
contenders.notes: Subject from the instances Vision separates that hold the eye (each one's sum of Vision's attention-based saliency, doubled where a face is, kept at a third of the most salient's or more), rather than every instance (MSK-39).

contenders.label: Redlamp, Subject outlined by Segment Anything 2.1 large
contenders.notes: Vision's Subject outlined again by Segment Anything 2.1 large: one prompt per part (its box and a point inside), then Redlamp's edges (MSK-39).

contenders.label: Redlamp, Sky with Segment Anything 2.1 base+
contenders.notes: Sky as Redlamp makes it, with Segment Anything 2.1 base+ (166 MB) in place of tiny (80 MB); the same licence and data as tiny (DEC-24), offered only for evaluation until measured (MSK-40).

contenders.label: Redlamp, Sky with Segment Anything 2.1 large
contenders.notes: Sky as Redlamp makes it, with Segment Anything 2.1 large (457 MB) in place of tiny (MSK-40).

contenders.label: BiRefNet (general)
contenders.notes: MIT weights (445 MB), trained partly on DIS5K, which is research-only; shipping it would need a decision row, as DEC-35 did for ViTMatte. Its region, then Redlamp's edges (Refine Edges).

contenders.label: BiRefNet (high resolution)
contenders.notes: MIT weights (445 MB) trained at 2048 px, on the same data as BiRefNet.

contenders.label: BiRefNet (lite)
contenders.notes: MIT weights (178 MB) on a smaller backbone (Swin-T), on the same data as BiRefNet.

contenders.label: BRIA RMBG-2.0
contenders.notes: BiRefNet's architecture trained on images BRIA licensed; CC BY-NC 4.0 weights, gated on Hugging Face (accept BRIA's terms with the account whose token this Mac has); shipping needs BRIA's commercial licence.

contenders.label: OneFormer (ADE20K) sky
contenders.notes: The ceiling MSK-17 measured against: MIT weights trained on ADE20K, whose images come partly from Places, so evaluation only (DEC-24). Its sky class, then SkyMatte's edges.

contenders.label: Lightroom desktop
contenders.notes: Decoded from Lightroom desktop's exports by `maskbench lightroom decode`; kept on this Mac only, with only numbers and verdicts in the repository (DEC-17, DEC-41).
